dedupe_keys.name: hydrowaste global database of wastewater treatment plants

description: HydroWASTE is a spatially explicit global database of 58,502 wastewater treatment plants and their characteristics. Its authors combined national and regional plant inventories with auxiliary information to derive or fill missing attributes, including the number of people served, the effluent flow rate and the level of treatment, and used the HydroSHEDS river network with streamflow estimates to locate each plant's outfall and co-register it to a reach of the HydroRIVERS database, so that the dilution of wastewater in rivers can be assessed at global scale. It was produced by the HydroSHEDS group and documented by Ehalt Macedo et al. in Earth System Science Data (2022), for water managers, policy makers and researchers working on the release of anthropogenic chemicals. Coverage is global, at point resolution, as a single version-1 snapshot. The data are a 2.3 MB download from the HydroSHEDS site under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, free of charge. Caveats: coverage and attribute quality follow the national sources, some attributes are modelled, not reported, and plants are not linked to their sewer catchments. Simulation uses: system description of wastewater treatment capacity for network models, flood or outage exposure of treatment plants, and planning of treatment capacity. It shares the HydroSHEDS river framework with the Global Dam Watch database (data-global-dam-watch-database).
